thesis: The pricing page's competing CTAs and the homepage's unsubstantiated social proof and security claims are the primary leaks, diluting the self-serve conversion path and undermining trust. The most valuable mechanism is the self-serve signup flow, which is being bled by multiple equally prominent CTAs on the pricing page and homepage, and by trust signals that are claimed but not evidenced.

findings.title: Homepage CTA clutter
findings.summary: Homepage offers multiple competing CTAs, diluting the primary signup path.
findings.problem: Homepage offers multiple competing CTAs, diluting the primary signup path.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Start for free as sole emphasized hero CTA; add Pricing as secondary CTA.; notes: Move desktop app and support to nav/footer.
findings.evidence: ctas: Book a demo | Start for free | Get the desktop app | Contact support
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Misleading 'Download' menu label
findings.summary: Footer groups Enterprise and Pricing under 'Download', mislabeling their destinations.
findings.problem: Footer groups Enterprise and Pricing under 'Download', mislabeling their destinations.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Split Enterprise and Pricing into separate labeled sections.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Competing CTAs on pricing
findings.summary: Multiple equally prominent CTAs on the pricing page dilute the primary action, confusing self-serve buyers.
findings.problem: Multiple equally prominent CTAs on the pricing page dilute the primary action, confusing self-serve buyers.
findings.recommended_change: cta: One primary CTA per tier, secondary actions demoted.; notes: Visually demote demo, sales, and desktop-app links.
findings.evidence: ctas: Book a demo | Start for free | Get Started | Contact Sales | Get the desktop app | Contact support
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: Unsubstantiated security claim
findings.summary: The security promise lacks visible certifications or details, reducing trust.
findings.problem: The security promise lacks visible certifications or details, reducing trust.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add compliance badges and security details.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Missing trust signals above fold
findings.summary: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
findings.problem: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Surface review counts, the returns window and a guarantee near the primary call to action.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: no match for returns policy, guarantee.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Lack of risk reversal on pricing
findings.summary: Pricing page offers no guarantee or refund statement near decision points, increasing perceived risk.
findings.problem: Pricing page offers no guarantee or refund statement near decision points, increasing perceived risk.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Get Started with no-risk guarantee; notes: Add refund or trial statement near pricing tiers.
findings.evidence: prices: $0 $9 /user $24 /user | ctas: Book a demo | Start for free | Get Started | Contact Sales | Get the desktop app | Contact support
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Per-user prices lack billing period
findings.summary: Paid tiers show per-user prices without specifying monthly or annual billing, causing confusion.
findings.problem: Paid tiers show per-user prices without specifying monthly or annual billing, causing confusion.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Append 'per month' or 'per year' to each price.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Enterprise email gate before value
findings.summary: Enterprise page leads with a business email capture, blocking access to pricing and product details.
findings.problem: Enterprise page leads with a business email capture, blocking access to pricing and product details.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Bring Voicenotes to your team; cta: Book a demo as primary; email capture later.; notes: Show indicative pricing or overview above email form.
